changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE notification ( id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '收件人', actor_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '触发者', type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT 'COMMENT/REPLY/LIKE/COLLECT/SYSTEM', source_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT 'POST/COMMENT', source_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, post_id BIGINT UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL, content VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, read_flag TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_time DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_notify (user_id, type, source_id, actor_id), KEY idx_notify_user (user_id, read_flag, created_time) ) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 COLLATE = utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT = '站内通知';
